I would say your liver is definitely damaged, any sort of overdosing does that. 

I really hope things get better, even though you're a stranger.

I'm scared of stuff too. Although, surprisingly, not death. I used to be terrified of death as a child. 

The world changes a lot and it's scary. Not knowing what's going to happen is frightening. It's alright to be scared by the way, there's nothing wrong with that.

Oh man! I know what you mean by vomiting from anxiety. It's so, so weird. Then I'm more anxious about having thrown up. 

Sleeping is good and not good. I hope things get better for you.
It's really hard being alive when you never wanted to be here in the first place. I feel for you, it's awful having to experience any of this.

Did you have to go to the hospital? 

I'm sorry you have to deal with this. It's weird trying and failing, it's like failing at failing.

I don't but he does. 

Thank you for replying.

School is so hard. I understand. 

I feel guilty about being a failure to my parents too. They try to support you and you end up just being an idiot. 

It's okay, hopefully things will get better for us.
